senses.gloss: f. (Assyr. makua, v. Fränkel Zeitschr. für Assyriol. III, p. 53; Proceed. Soc. for Bibl. Archaeol. 1887, p. 103) a certain kind of boat, (low boat?).
units: Keth. 69ᵇ אסקריא דמ׳; (Taan. 21ᵃ דספינתא, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 300), v. אִסְקַרְיָא; [Rashi: sail].
B. Bath. 161ᵇ (צייר) מ׳ drew a ship in place of his name (Rashb. mast); Gitt. 36ᵃ; 87ᵇ (Rashi: sail-yard).
